description: Beyond the op-v6s.15.9 halo-exchange first slice: distribute the global linear solve across ranks -- distributed matrix-vector products + a parallel Krylov method (all_reduce for dot products), plus multi-dimensional / unstructured domain partitioning. Uses outram-park-mpi collectives.
title: pflotran: fully MPI-parallel implicit solve (distributed Jacobian + Krylov)

description:
FIXED 2026-08-12 in the same change that landed the nodalised steam generator, recorded because the CLASS of defect will recur.

WHAT HAPPENED. examples/htgr_sim_v1/app/mod.rs steps the plant at PHYSICS_DT_S = 1.0e-3 s, ten sub-steps per 10 ms tick, to keep the animation smooth. Every test in the suite steps at 0.05 s. The nodalised steam generator's fluid arrays are unstable BELOW about 0.005 s (the water side starts resolving its own acoustic transient and the IAPWS-IF97 (p,h) flash leaves Region 5 range and panics), so the whole suite was green while the simulator killed its physics thread within 30 s of launch:

  [physics thread panicked] htgr-physics failed in helium primary loop (circulator + hot gas duct): (p,h) point lies above the 1073.15 K isotherm. (p,h) flash into IAPWS-IF97 Region 5 (T > 1073.15 K) is unsupported.

FIX. SteamGeneratorConfig::substep is now a FIXED accumulate-and-advance clock rather than a 'subdivide to at most this' bound: the exchanger accumulates whatever dt the caller passes and advances the arrays in whole 0.0125 s steps, carrying the remainder. That makes it a multi-rate sub-model, which is also what its physics wants -- nothing in it moves on a millisecond scale.

REGRESSION TESTS ADDED (both would have caught it):
- physics::steam_generator::tests::the_gui_millisecond_timestep_reaches_the_same_state -- drives the exchanger over the same 100 s at 0.05 s and at 1 ms and asserts they agree. Measured: identical to 0.0000 K and +0.0000% on duty.
- physics::tests::the_whole_plant_steps_at_the_gui_timestep -- 20 000 plant steps at 1 ms, end to end.

THE GENERAL LESSON, worth acting on beyond this bug: a test suite that drives a plant at a timestep the application does not use is not testing the application. Any future sub-model with a stability window (and the coolprop / steam-tables arrays all have one) needs at least one test at the app's real rate. Consider making PHYSICS_DT_S visible to the physics module so a test can assert against it rather than hard-coding 1.0e-3 in two places.
title: htgr_sim_v1: the GUI stepped the plant at a rate no test drove, and it crashed
